title: Irish Bacon Pasta Bake
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with zesty pasta, crispy bacon, and a hint of irish flair. Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Cook irish bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add a splash of milk and stir to combine with any remaining bacon drippings.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the milk mixture.
Stir in grated cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with crispy bacon.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
